description: Add a new benefit to a card. Generates periods automatically based on schedule_type. For mid-year additions or perks not yet in the catalog. Returns 409 if a benefit with the same name already exists on the card (catalog-backed or custom). Pass force=true to override and create a duplicate intentionally.

card_id.description: The card this benefit belongs to

category.description: Category: travel, dining, fitness, shopping, etc. (default: other)

dry_run.description: Set true to validate without persisting. Returns what would be created. Use for smoke tests.

force.description: Set true to bypass duplicate-name check and create a duplicate anyway. Default false — duplicates return 409.

name: create_benefit
